slots.title: UBS now flags two 2026 Fed hikes
slots.body:
UBS now expects two Federal Reserve rate hikes in 2026 — 25 basis points in September and again in December — after the August jobs report came in stronger than expected, Invezz reports.

The bank had previously called for no policy changes this year.

On the latest FMP Treasury snapshot (2026-09-04), the 10-year yield was 4.8% and the 2-year was 4.4% — a 2s10s spread of 0.41 percentage points.

slots.title: US session recap — Sept. 7, 2026
slots.body:
The calendar slot in the feed marks 2026-09-07 as a US Labour Day holiday with no market impact flag; the price tables still carry a full US equity and cross-asset snapshot for that dated run.

The S&P 500 finished at 7,718.60, down 29.11 points (-0.4%), with an intraday range of 7,706.12 to 7,750.19.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at 53,414.25 (-0.5%), while the Nasdaq Composite settled at 26,506.99 (-0.3%).
The Russell 2000 was a outlier among US indexes at 2,975.65 (+0.2%).

The CBOE Volatility Index rose to 15.30, up 0.77 points (+5.3%) from a prior close of 14.53, with a session high of 15.32 in the feed.

Sector averages on Nasdaq showed Utilities up 3.4% and Technology up 0.7%, against Consumer Defensive (-0.9%), Consumer Cyclical (-0.9%), Energy (-0.8%), and Communication Services (-0.6%).
Healthcare was nearly flat at 0.0% in the table; Real Estate averaged +0.1%.

Megacap technology and consumer platforms were mostly lower: Apple closed at 319.97 (-2.5%), Microsoft at 499.70 (-2.0%), Alphabet (GOOG) at 335.31 (-1.1%), and Netflix at 78.25 (-5.3%).
Meta bucked that pattern at 616.77 (+1.0%).

Semiconductor and chip-equipment names were strong on the same close: Advanced Micro Devices finished at 477.57 (+4.7%), ASML at 1,714.88 (+4.2%), and Intel at 95.80 (+4.5%).
NVIDIA closed at 230.36 (+0.8%) on heavy volume of 135.35 million shares in the megacap block.

Oracle rose 3.1% to 158.83, while Salesforce slipped 2.0% to 259.23.
Among liquid decliners in the screen, Lululemon was down 17.4% to 100.61, Guidewire down 19.9% to 162.42, Fair Isaac down 16.7% to 932.26, and UiPath down 16.6% to 15.19.

The earnings calendar array in this injection is empty; no after-close EPS lines are attached to the package.

Treasury yields in the feed are dated 2026-09-04, with the 10-year at 4.8% and the 2s10s spread at 0.41 percentage points in the snapshot.

Brent crude in the cross-asset block was up 1.2% at 97.39; gold futures were down 0.2% at 4,466.10.
The US dollar proxy (UUP) rose 0.2% to 28.08, and Bitcoin was down 0.2% at 78,923.45.

Overseas indexes in the same file were mixed: the Nikkei 225 was up 0.1% at 66,445.13, the Hang Seng down 0.6% at 25,252.00, and the FTSE 100 down 0.1% at 10,822.13.

Headlines in the news bundle point to Middle East oil supply stress and investors looking ahead to US consumer inflation data after the holiday; regional Asian equity coverage cited mixed trading with US CPI on the calendar.
